# Brand U Max

> Brand U Max is an AI-first branding and business growth consultant helping ambitious brands build identity, open new growth channels, and scale revenue and profit.

Brand U Max combines branding, business growth strategy, and AI-driven marketing execution in one team. Unlike agencies that only deliver strategy decks, Brand U Max runs day-to-day execution across SEO, paid advertising, social media marketing, conversion optimization, and analytics.

Based in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India.

## Services

- Social media content creation
- Promotional video production
- Website design and development
- SEO and content marketing
- Paid advertising (Google Ads)
- Social media advertising (Meta Ads)
- Branding and creative
- Conversion rate optimization
- Email and CRM marketing
- Business growth strategy consulting
